# System Spec

> An open format for a complete, implementation-neutral specification of a software system: existing standards (Cedar,
> use cases with Gherkin, JSON Schema, Alloy, IFML, OpenAPI 3.1, AsyncAPI 3, SCXML, ISO 25010 scenarios, OpenSLO, ASVS,
> WCAG, Open Threat Model, C4, MADR) combined in one bundle, with mechanical readiness rules.

- [SPEC.md](SPEC.md): the normative specification
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent writes or reviews a bundle
- [schema/manifest.schema.json](schema/manifest.schema.json): the bundle manifest, with x-fill instructions on each field
- [docs/tooling.md](docs/tooling.md): tools for each layer
- [docs/extending.md](docs/extending.md): adding layers and formats
- [template/](template/): an empty bundle
